## What contradicts what

**Governing text** — objectui `AGENTS.md`, 受管面 section, the landing sentence (ruling C, maintainer 2026-09-13, quoted verbatim on that page): 「命中即停 draft;⛔ 未获授权批准不 ready 不入队不自合、永不批准,获批后认领席落地。」 and 「C. approve 后不管后续改动都由席位落地:」. Since PR #10413 (card #9449) the guard `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` prints that same order in its `--test` answer, its merge-queue refusal and its early warning: DRAFT first, then an authorized APPROVED review (which IS the review record), then the claiming seat readies it and arms auto-merge, and the queue lands it.

Two texts that describe that guard still say the opposite:

1. `AGENTS.md`, the same 受管面 section, the report-only backstop paragraph (the one beginning 「本仓的机械兜底只有一件」): 「而这道拒绝先印的补救仍是转回 draft、交人类合并」. The guard's first-printed remedy is no longer 「交人类合并」; after #10413 it is back-to-draft, then the authorized approval, then the claiming seat lands it. Governed surface ⇒ Tier H, the maintainer's approval.
2. `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, section 「Governed Surface Queue Guard」: 「The remedy the refusal prints first is not approval at all — convert the pull request back to a draft and leave the merge to the maintainer.」, 「under this regime the human merge *is* the review record」, 「A governed pull request sitting as a draft for the maintainer to merge by hand is the *healthy* end state」. Docs face (`content/docs/**`); `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` pins none of these sentences.

Seam: AGENTS.md ruling-C landing sentence → guard: `renderGuardVerdict` / `renderTestVerdict` printed remedies (aligned by #10413) → docs: the `ci-cd-pipeline.md` guard section and the AGENTS.md backstop paragraph (not aligned); consumer: seats reading either text at landing time.
